outcome_evidence: The oven door is open at frame 0 in image and left_ego_image. The robot approaches and aligns with the door, then raises it toward the oven during frames 47–70. By frames 71–76, image and left_ego_image show the door upright against the oven front. It remains closed as the robot withdraws through frame 93; wrist_image also shows the closed door alongside the retreating gripper. No failed attempt or unintended displacement of surrounding objects is visible.
